title: Compute Cheap — The world’s cheapest GPU compute
excerpt: H100 and H200 capacity without the hyperscaler bill.
content_html:
The world's cheapestGPU compute.

H200 and H100 capacity for training, inference, and everything in between. Historically delivering some of the lowest prices for frontier AI.

Explore GPUsRequest

Lowest-price GPU capacity

Cheapest on spot. Cheapest on-demand.

The economics

Why is it so cheap?

  1. 01

    Competition sets the floor.

    The marketplace model lets capacity owners compete for workloads instead of hiding prices behind fixed tiers.

  2. 02

    Idle capacity gets a job.

    Cheaper GPU clouds make use of available hardware, turning underused infrastructure into useful compute.

  3. 03

    Reserved, not idle.

    Prepaid blocks are quoted at the on-demand rate after availability is confirmed. No multi-year contracts; capacity is reserved after payment.

  4. 04

    A smaller stack.

    We are built around the GPU—not a maze of managed services and layers of enterprise overhead.
